fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Points the rod and sends a hound at the first enemy in its path; it deals 18 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Whole Pack In
fusions.desc: Sets the pack on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for a mauling that deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Heel to Me
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Throne-Side Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound keeps to your side, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
